rationale: The assistant correctly advised isolating at the cooker switch and letting the oven cool, removing the cover without force, and reading the old bulb before buying, then confirmed an oven-rated E14/SES 300C lamp once the customer reported 'E14, 25W, 300C' with a broken filament, matching the hidden truth exactly. It explicitly warned against fitting an ordinary household bulb and gave an appropriate fallback (lamp holder/wiring, engineer) if the new lamp fails. No evidence was invented, confidence was proportionate, and the part recommendation was justified by the customer's own reading of the old bulb. Minor nit: it did not explicitly restate '25W' in the final confirmation, though 'E14/SES 300C lamp' matched to the old bulb is adequate.
